title: Subinvariant kernel dynamics
summary: We study positive definite kernels pulled back along a finite family of self-maps under a subinvariance inequality for the associated branching operator. Iteration produces an increasing kernel tower with defect kernels. Under diagonal boundedness, the tower has a smallest invariant majorant, with a canonical defect space realization and an explicit diagonal harmonic envelope governing finiteness versus blow-up.
